mapper.sql: printer_id, plant_cd, printer_cd, printer_nm, lang, host, port, dpi, usage, use_yn, remark, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by, cjk_font_yn, cjk_font_file, media_width_mm, status_check_yn, conn_mode, agent_terminal_id, (select a.terminal_cd from sys_terminal a where a.terminal_id = wms_printer.agent_terminal_id) as agent_terminal_cd, (select a.last_seen_at from sys_terminal a where a.terminal_id = wms_printer.agent_terminal_id) as agent_seen_at, st.state_cd as printer_state, st.errors as status_errors, st.warnings as status_warnings, st.odometer, st.checked_at
left join lateral (select s.state_cd, s.errors, s.warnings, s.odometer, s.checked_at from wms_printer_status s where s.printer_id = wms_printer.printer_id) st on true
mapper.select:
select order by
printer_cd printer_nm usage updated_at plant_cd
desc,
printer_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from wms_printer where printer_id = #{id}

insert into wms_printer (comp_cd, plant_cd, printer_cd, printer_nm, host, port, dpi, usage, use_yn, remark, cjk_font_yn, cjk_font_file, media_width_mm, status_check_yn, conn_mode, agent_terminal_id, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.printerCd}, #{f.printerNm}, #{f.host}, #{f.port}, #{f.dpi}, #{f.usage}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{f.cjkFontYn}, #{f.cjkFontFile}, #{f.mediaWidthMm}, #{f.statusCheckYn}, #{f.connMode}, #{f.agentTerminalId}, #{by}, #{by}) returning printer_id
mapper.update: update wms_printer set printer_nm = #{f.printerNm}, host = #{f.host}, port = #{f.port}, dpi = #{f.dpi}, usage = #{f.usage}, use_yn = #{f.useYn}, remark = #{f.remark}, cjk_font_yn = #{f.cjkFontYn}, cjk_font_file = #{f.cjkFontFile}, media_width_mm = #{f.mediaWidthMm}, status_check_yn = #{f.statusCheckYn}, conn_mode = #{f.connMode}, agent_terminal_id = #{f.agentTerminalId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where printer_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer}
mapper.select: select terminal_id as "terminalId", terminal_cd as "terminalCd", terminal_nm as "terminalNm", plant_cd as "plantCd", last_seen_at as "lastSeenAt", coalesce(last_seen_at > now() - make_interval(secs => #{offlineSec}), false) as "online" from sys_terminal where terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' and revoked_at is null order by terminal_cd
select exists (select 1 from sys_terminal where terminal_id = #{id} and terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' and revoked_at is null)
select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and use_yn = 'Y')
mapper.sql: tpl_id, label_type, tpl_cd, tpl_nm, width_mm, height_mm, size_cd, dpi, body, default_yn, use_yn, remark, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select:
select order by
tpl_cd tpl_nm updated_at label_type
desc,
tpl_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*)
select from wms_label_tpl where tpl_id = #{id}
select from wms_label_tpl where label_type = #{labelType} and default_yn = 'Y'

insert into wms_label_tpl (comp_cd, label_type, tpl_cd, tpl_nm, width_mm, height_mm, dpi, body, default_yn, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.labelType}, #{f.tplCd}, #{f.tplNm}, #{f.widthMm}, #{f.heightMm}, #{f.dpi}, #{f.body}, #{f.defaultYn}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning tpl_id

insert into wms_print_job (comp_cd, plant_cd, printer_id, tpl_id, label_type, biz_key, label_values, zpl, zpl_sha256, copies, test_yn, outbox_message_id, reprint_of_id, reprint_reason, requested_by, conn_mode) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{printerId}, #{tplId}, #{labelType}, #{bizKey}, #{valuesJson}::jsonb, #{zpl}, #{sha}, #{copies}, #{testYn}, #{messageId}, #{reprintOf}, #{reason}, #{by}, #{connMode}) returning job_id
mapper.sql: j.job_id, j.plant_cd, j.label_type, j.biz_key, j.copies, j.test_yn, j.reprint_of_id, j.reprint_reason, j.requested_by, j.requested_at, j.printer_id, p.printer_cd, p.printer_nm, j.tpl_id, t.tpl_cd, j.zpl_sha256, o.status, o.attempts, o.last_error, o.sent_at, j.conn_mode, as print_state, (select count(*) from wms_print_job_event w where w.job_id = j.job_id and w.event_cd in ('WARN', 'VERIFY_NG'))::int as warn_count

coalesce((select e.event_cd from wms_print_job_event e where e.job_id = j.job_id and e.event_cd in ('CLAIMED', 'SENT', 'PRINTED', 'VERIFIED', 'PRINTER_ERROR', 'FAILED', 'UNKNOWN', 'CANCELLED') order by e.event_id desc limit 1), case o.status when 'SENT' then 'SENT' when 'FAIL' then 'FAILED' when 'CLOSED_MANUAL' then 'CANCELLED' else 'QUEUED' end)

from wms_print_job j join wms_printer p on p.printer_id = j.printer_id join wms_label_tpl t on t.tpl_id = j.tpl_id left join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd
mapper.select: select from (select j.job_id order by limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}) k join wms_print_job j on j.job_id = k.job_id join wms_printer p on p.printer_id = j.printer_id join wms_label_tpl t on t.tpl_id = j.tpl_id left join sys_outbox o on o.message_id = j.outbox_message_id and o.comp_cd = j.comp_cd order by
select count(*)

select , j.label_values::text as label_values, j.zpl
where j.job_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: r.rule_id, r.label_type, r.scope_cd, r.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.tpl_id, t.tpl_cd, t.tpl_nm, r.use_yn, r.remark, r.row_ver, r.updated_at
from wms_label_tpl_rule r join wms_label_tpl t on t.tpl_id = r.tpl_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id
mapper.select: select where r.rule_id = #{id}

insert into wms_label_tpl_rule (comp_cd, label_type, scope_cd, cust_id, item_id, tpl_id, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.labelType}, #{f.scopeCd}, #{f.custId}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.tplId}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning rule_id
select exists (select 1 from mst_cust where cust_id = #{id} and use_yn = 'Y')
select exists (select 1 from mst_item where item_id = #{id} and use_yn = 'Y')

select r.tpl_id from wms_label_tpl_rule r join wms_label_tpl t on t.tpl_id = r.tpl_id and t.use_yn = 'Y' where r.label_type = #{labelType} and r.use_yn = 'Y' and ((r.scope_cd = 'CUST' and r.cust_id = #{custId}) or (r.scope_cd = 'ITEM' and r.item_id = #{itemId})) order by case r.scope_cd when 'CUST' then 1 else 2 end limit 1
